objective: Identify student needs and pain points in course discovery and registration.
findings: Students need course search, class detail visibility, registration, schedule-conflict prevention, registered-class viewing, cancellation and notifications.

objective: Understand class lifecycle, user administration and operational reporting needs.
findings: Administrators need to create, edit, cancel and monitor classes, enforce permissions and view statistics.
Lecturers need a scoped view of assigned teaching sections and schedules without access to unrelated classes.

objective: Resolve business rules for registration validation.
findings: Registration must validate section status, capacity, duplicate registration, program eligibility and schedule overlap before commit.
Role-based access is required for administrative functions; protected routes and APIs must reject unauthorized users.

objective: Review approved change requests and their impact.
findings: Cancellation, student cancellation, class editing, notifications, statistics, lecturer workspace and authorization improvements were prioritized.

objective: Validate traceability between requirements, use cases and tests and identify known gaps.
findings: 35 test cases cover functional, negative, boundary, security, integration and data-integrity flows; two known implementation gaps require follow-up.
